hero.eyebrow: The Palm Collection · Three Pieces. Never Repeated.
hero.title: Dubai, on your wrist.
hero.subtitle: Three automatic watches built around one idea: the Palm, drawn into the dial. One of each finish. When they're gone, they're gone.

collection.title: The Collection
collection.subtitle: Three watches. Three owners. That's it.

dial.title: Why the Palm.
dial.body1: Some places you visit. Dubai is a place you carry with you. The Palm is its signature, a shape you recognise from the sky and never forget.
dial.body2: I designed the dial around it and built each watch by hand from carefully chosen parts. Then I stopped at three. No series, no restock, no second edition.

about.title: One maker. Three watches.
about.body: This isn't a store. It's a small personal project: a watch I wanted to exist, made in three finishes. Every piece is inspected, wound and tested before it ships. You deal directly with me, from the first message to the tracking number.

policy.title: Before you buy
policy.subtitle: Four things to know.
policy.b1Body: Each watch exists only once. The piece you see is the piece you receive.
policy.b2Body: 12 months on the movement. If it stops keeping time, I'll repair it.
policy.b3Body: Free tracked worldwide shipping. Import duties and taxes in your country are paid by the buyer.
policy.b4Body: Private sale, not a retail establishment.

contact.title: Claim yours before someone else does.
contact.subtitle: Message me directly. I usually reply within the hour.

motion.title: See them in Dubai.
motion.subtitle: Filmed at the foot of Burj Khalifa.
